youtube-transcript.description: YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract clean transcript, captions or subtitles from any YouTube URL or video ID. Choose manual or auto-generated captions, select language, optionally translate, and return JSON, plain text or SRT for RAG, research, summarization and automation.

url.description: YouTube video URL for transcript, captions, subtitles or video-to-text extraction.

sourcePreference.description: Caption source: any, manual, or generated.

translateTo.description: Optional target language code for YouTube caption translation.

format.description: Output format: json, text or srt.

formatted.description: Transcript rendered as plain text or SRT when requested.

youtube-captions.description: YouTube captions and subtitle extractor for AI agents. Get clean captions, subtitles or transcript from a YouTube URL or video ID with JSON, plain text or SRT-ready output, optional timestamps and language selection.

url.description: YouTube URL to extract captions, subtitles or transcript.

format.description: Output format: json, text or srt.

youtube-video-to-text.description: YouTube video-to-text API. Convert a YouTube video URL or video ID into clean transcript text with JSON, plain text or SRT-ready output. Low-cost endpoint for AI agents, RAG pipelines, research, indexing and automation.

url.description: YouTube URL to convert to text.

format.description: Output format: json, text or srt.

youtube-metadata.description: YouTube metadata API for AI agents. Resolve a YouTube URL or video ID into title, channel, canonical video URL and thumbnail metadata without API keys. Cheap lookup for routing, enrichment, indexing and preflight checks before buying a transcript.

youtube-transcript-batch.description: Batch YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract clean transcripts from 2 or 3 YouTube videos in one paid request, with per-video success/failure results and optional language selection. Built for RAG ingestion, research, summarization, dataset creation and automation workflows.

videos.description: Array of 2 or 3 YouTube URLs/video IDs.

language.description: Optional preferred transcript language code applied to all videos.

results.description: Per-video transcript results with success/failure details.
